events.title: New Demo Update: Gang Event Cards
events.summary: New Feature: Gang Event CardsA new Event Card system is now available in the demo!Every Wednesday in the game, you can choose an Event Card to strengthen your gang and shape your strategy. Each gang has its own unique set of Event Cards, working like perks in roguelike games and offering new ways to build your gang throughout each run.Event Cards of the same type can be selected multiple times, but only the highest level takes effect.Try them out and let us know what you think!
